title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ‘Resilient Communities’ project in Pibor County in South Sudan, implemented by Oxfam through ICSP will directly reach 27,000 returnees, internally displaced persons and host communities. Oxfam will partner in 2026 with Coalition for Humanity and continue partnerships with government and CSOs to ensure that these conflict-affected communities especially women and youth will have improved resilience to protect, adopt and absorb shocks from all forms of disasters through integrated food security, climate resilience, gender, good governance and peace building interventions. This programme outcome focuses on building capacity of smallholder farmers on climate smart agriculture, soil and natural resource conservation, organic manure making and application, cultivation of drought tolerant crops, irrigation, mechanisation, postharvest management to reduce harvest losses and use of renewable energy in food production and value chains. This is a critical intervention under this impact area of the programme and would have not been funded if this intervention was not implemented.
